entries.rationale: The primary route entry carries the positioning statement and the first consultation actions, so it is delivery-critical and must remain explicitly traceable.
This action routes the user from the primary route entry to the contact surface and is therefore a delivery-critical conversion decision.
This action exposes the paid diagnostic path from the primary route entry and must be independently traceable from the general contact action.
The section separates urgent and non-urgent user situations into distinct next actions, making it a functional route-decision surface.
The section states specialization, personal handling, proximity and prior authority experience, so its presence materially supports the service positioning.
The section combines the trajectory narrative with quantitative practice indicators and therefore forms a distinct evidence surface.
The section is the route-level index into the legal service areas and must remain traceable as navigation rather than decorative content.
The section exposes selected case narratives as experience evidence and is a separate delivery claim surface from general positioning.
The section presents a named paid service and price, so it is a commercially material surface that requires explicit provenance.
The section contains the office location, direct contact channels, message fields and map access, making it the final route-level contact surface.
